queries.query: Sarh Chad cadastral map parcel cadastre official registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Chad's Service de la Cartographie, Direction du Cadastre; the official ANATS site lists a CAU de Sarh in Moyen-Chari; and official Chad finance material names Sarh in land/cadastral fee provisions. No public anonymous Sarh parcel viewer or parcel API was found.

requests.outcome: Fetched the official JavaScript application shell; inspected its current main bundle and found no exposed anonymous parcel API, schema, CRS, or bounded ID-plus-geometry response. The page is otherwise JavaScript-rendered.
Fetched the official government portal shell; no anonymous cadastral map/API route was exposed.
Direct curl request was denied by the site; first-party search result independently exposed the authority and no-datasets statement. TLS was not bypassed.

TLS certificate validation failed because the certificate had no matching alternative subject name for finances.gouv.td. TLS verification was not disabled; the official document was retained as first-party discovery evidence only.
